name: Can insulation upgrades help with soundproofing my home?

mainEntity.name: Can insulation upgrades help with soundproofing my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an insulation upgrade can significantly contribute to soundproofing your home. Denser insulation materials, such as blown-in cellulose or certain types of fiberglass batts, are particularly effective at absorbing sound waves, reducing noise transfer from outside or between rooms. Spray foam insulation also provides excellent sound dampening due to its air-sealing properties, which block airborne sound paths. While insulation primarily focuses on thermal resistance, its secondary benefit of noise reduction is a welcome advantage for many homeowners seeking a quieter indoor environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, denser insulation like cellulose or spray foam can significantly reduce noise transfer from outside and between rooms, improving soundproofing.
